containers.name: prepare
args:
import subprocess,sys,os,pathlib,json
p=pathlib.Path('/prepared')
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'/source/mistt/prepare_model.py','--pins','/source/mistt/model-pins.json','--output','/prepared/whisper'],check=True)
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'/source/narrate/stage_assets.py','--hub','/hub','--pocket-package','/deps/pocket_tts','--output','/prepared/anna'],check=True)
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','pip','install','--quiet','--require-hashes','--target','/prepared/deps','-r','/source/mistt/requirements.lock'],check=True)
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','pip','install','--quiet','--no-deps','--target','/prepared/pocket','https://github.com/kyutai-labs/pocket-tts/archive/b94db177bc0f77517d9b124843e25605d6f9aed8.tar.gz'],check=True)
(p/'ready').write_text('prepared pinned speech assets and dependencies\n')
print('PREPARATION_COMPLETE',flush=True)
